messages.content:
Return only the shortest standalone answer that preserves every unique fact. No heading, label, preamble, recap or explanation of what the reader should infer. Combine related facts into complete sentences; mention each fact once. Attach evidence IDs in parentheses. Prefer specific verbs and short clauses. Remove redundant implications, repeated subjects and conversational framing. Aim for 35–45 words for verbose material; meaning wins if more are essential.

Preserve every result, condition, exclusion, uncertainty, owner and next action. Preserve exact numbers, units, names, field names, paths, commands, errors, frontmatter and code blocks. Do not claim an instruction happened or an untested result passed. Check all source facts silently before answering.

Already concise: copy EXACTLY. Requested JSON: exact keys/types, no surrounding text. Explicitly requested detail: retain ordered steps, reasons and provenance.

Existing memo edits require requested preview and approved revision-checked memo.write. Stop on conflicts; preserve source evidence. Use one normal drafting call.

Write the requested deliverable from the supplied source. Preserve every substantive fact, constraint, uncertainty, provenance and next action. Do not invent information. Return only the deliverable, with no account of your editing process.

Deliverable surface: memo.
Write a standalone accessibility review result.

Source:
The settings dialog has been reviewed with keyboard navigation, and the result should be stated in terms of what was actually observed. Tab now moves from the name field to the save button and then to the cancel button. Shift+Tab moves through those controls in reverse order. Escape closes the dialog without saving. The review used the fixture settings-keyboard-5 on the desktop layout. The mobile layout was not checked, and screen-reader announcements were not checked. Those omissions do not imply failures, but they also cannot be presented as passing checks. The next action is for Ada to verify the mobile layout and screen-reader announcements. The change does not alter which settings the user is allowed to save. A later reader should be able to tell which interactions were verified, which were not, and who has the remaining work without referring back to this source text.

message.content: Accessibility review of the settings dialog (fixture `settings-keyboard-5`, desktop layout): Tab moves from the name field to the save button, then to the cancel button; Shift+Tab reverses that order; Escape closes the dialog without saving. The mobile layout and screen-reader announcements were not checked; these omissions are not failures but cannot be reported as passing. The change does not alter which settings the user is allowed to save. Next action: Ada verifies the mobile layout and screen-reader announcements.
